comment:
* A specification of a forward PKIX validation state
 * which is initialized by each build and updated each time a
 * certificate is added to the current path.
 * @since       1.4
 * @author      Yassir Elley

variables.name: issuerDN
variables.comment: The issuer DN of the last cert in the path

variables.name: cert
variables.comment: The last cert in the path

variables.name: subjectNamesTraversed
variables.comment: The set of subjectDNs and subjectAltNames of all certs in the path

variables.name: traversedCACerts
variables.comment:
* The number of intermediate CA certs which have been traversed so
     * far in the path

variables.name: init
variables.comment: Flag indicating if state is initial (path is just starting)

variables.name: forwardCheckers
variables.comment: The list of user-defined checkers that support forward checking

variables.name: keyParamsNeededFlag
variables.comment:
Flag indicating if key needing to inherit key parameters has been
     * encountered.

methods.name: public boolean isInitial()
methods.comment:
* Returns a boolean flag indicating if the state is initial
     * (just starting)
     *
     * @return boolean flag indicating if the state is initial (just starting)

methods.name: public boolean keyParamsNeeded()
methods.comment:
* Return boolean flag indicating whether a public key that needs to inherit
     * key parameters has been encountered.
     *
     * @return boolean true if key needing to inherit parameters has been
     * encountered; false otherwise.

methods.name: public void initState(List<PKIXCertPathChecker> certPathCheckers) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Initialize the state.
     *
     * @param certPathCheckers the list of user-defined PKIXCertPathCheckers

methods.name: public void updateState(X509Certificate cert) throws CertificateException, IOException, CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Update the state with the next certificate added to the path.
     *
     * @param cert the certificate which is used to update the state

methods.name: public Object clone()
methods.comment:
* Clone current state. The state is cloned as each cert is
     * added to the path. This is necessary if backtracking occurs,
     * and a prior state needs to be restored.
     *
     * Note that this is a SMART clone. Not all fields are fully copied,
     * because some of them will
     * not have their contents modified by subsequent calls to updateState.

methodNames: public void initState(List<PKIXCertPathChecker> certPathCheckers) throws CertPathValidatorException
public void updateState(X509Certificate cert) throws CertificateException, IOException, CertPathValidatorException
